title: 4. Approachable
slide_intent: Define the limits of approachability so writers can express personality without creating the wrong impression.
strategic_value: Plain conversational language can make Burger King’s food and service feel accessible.
demonstration: Clear, real and friendly language is bounded by cautions against terseness, pretension and false friendliness. The right column compares direct invitations and ingredient descriptions with officious, ornate and implausible copy.
practical_value: Replace formal or inflated wording with something a person would naturally say.
